kind: Continuous controlled combat-route simulation, not human playtime or balance acceptance
assumptions: No injected HP, XP, levels, inventory or resources. All authored combats; all room evidence and supply caches; no side quests. Existing Rogue/Fighter companions, greedy legal-action hero policy, automatic companions. Short/extra Hit Dice rests for injuries, long rest for remaining injuries or half-depleted slots when legal. First available ability improvements. JSON save round-trip at room boundaries. Failure stops that run; no retries or checkpoint resets. In-game rest hours are not player hours. No paid AI.
